text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's somewhere I want to stop by
today too. Would that be alright?
choice_data_list: Of course. Where are we going?
Of course. Where are we going?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's that cherry pie shop we searched for together before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
With Jordan-chan's help, I've narrowed it down quite a bit.
I think it might be the shopping district in the next town over.
choice_data_list: Okay, shall we go take a look?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Umm, a red roof, a red roof is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute seemed to have spotted something. Right in her line of sight was a shop with a matching red roof.

text_block_list.name: Cake Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Welcome!
Are you here to order a cake?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Um, there's something I'd like to ask.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told the shopkeeper that I had visited this shop long ago
and asked if they still sold the cherry pie I had back then.

text_block_list.name: Cake Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Cherry pie, you say...? That must have been
from back when my grandmother ran the place.
To tell you the truth, I inherited this shop from her.

text_block_list.name: Cake Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: I did inherit a few recipes, but... we don't serve the cherry pie right now.

text_block_list.name: Cake Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because we haven't stocked the ingredients.
I'm sorry, especially since you came all the way here, but—

text_block_list.name: Cake Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But I have the recipe!
If that works for you, I can share it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, that's a lifesaver~.
In that case, would it be alright if I took some?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm so delighted.
I get to taste that flavor again, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She must have been wondering about it quite a bit.
Wonder Acute's smile was filled with pure joy."
choice_data_list: (At least I'm glad we found the recipe.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After buying some sweets as a thank-you,
I bought the ingredients needed for the cherry pie
and returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And before the day was out, the pie was baked.
It seems Copano Rickey and Hokko Tarumae
were invited as well."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~. The nutmeg-spiced
cherry pie is fresh out of the oven. Please, enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, what a cute and energetic pink!
—Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm, mmm~!! Mmmmmph~!!
It's delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san!!
This is super delicious!!
It feels like it'll bring in a ton of happiness!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It has such a nostalgic feel to it~!
It warms your heart right up, with a deliciousness that's totally different from haskap...♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Really?
I'm glad you liked it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you enjoy eating it,
then all that searching was totally worth it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Wonder Acute look so relieved,
a sudden thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, feels like it'll bring good fortune!
Now I want to eat it too!
You're curious about it too, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... they kept searching for it
because we mentioned wanting to eat it
back then...?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Delicious food tastes even better
when you eat it together with everyone, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it's really nothing special.
Something like this is no trouble at all, anytime.
choice_data_list: You're really thoughtful when it comes to your friends, huh.
You're so thoughtful toward your friends, aren't you?
You're really good at making sweets, huh.
You're really good at making sweets, aren't you?
I'll make you something to thank you next time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it's really nothing special.
Something like this is no trouble at all, anytime.
choice_data_list: You're really thoughtful when it comes to your friends, huh.
You're so thoughtful toward your friends, aren't you?
You're really good at making sweets, huh.
You're really good at making sweets, aren't you?
I'll make you something to thank you next time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho, you're making me blush.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you know, everyone is so kind and warm,
it makes me want to do something in return.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's fun for me to make, and everyone eating it gets so happy—it really is such a wonderful thing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told her that this cherry pie, just like the other treats she made, was absolutely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: My, my, hearing that makes me want to bake even more!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Not to brag, but I can make plenty of other dishes too, you know♪"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Right, maybe I should make traditional sweets next time.
Like dango, or warabi mochi.
Ohagi sounds lovely too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling bad about always being cooked for, I told them I wasn't sure if it would turn out well, but I wanted to give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that true?
That sounds like so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll make one with you.
If the two of us work on it together, I'm sure it'll turn out wonderful~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That hardly counts as a proper thank-you, but...
If Wonder Acute is fine with it,
maybe it's okay.
